models.name: Heartbeat detection
limits: Paced and very noisy records are hardest (record 108: Se 82%).

models.name: Signal quality (M1)
models.tested_on: Unseen MIT-BIH patients with calibrated noise; CinC 2017 expert labels
limits: Trained on Holter lead II, not 12-lead: rates ~20% of clean 12-lead leads 'noisy'.

models.name: Beat classifier (M2)
models.tested_on: 22 unseen MIT-BIH patients (inter-patient, end to end)
limits: Supraventricular beats weak (Se 32%); fusion beats not recognised.

models.name: Rhythm / AF (M3)
models.task: Sinus / AF / other / too noisy, per 30 s
models.tested_on: CinC 2017 test split; fresh MIT-BIH AF Database patients; MIT-BIH test records
limits: Over-calls AF when ectopic beats are frequent (MIT-BIH test PPV 60%).

models.name: 12-lead diagnostic statements (M4)
models.task: Diagnoses and descriptions from a 10 s 12-lead ECG
models.tested_on: PTB-XL test fold (Germany); Chapman–Shaoxing held out (China)
limits: Women 0.917 vs men 0.939 (superclass AUC) — under investigation.
Yes/no thresholds must be set per hospital.

models.name: 12-lead measurements (M4)
models.task: Heart rate, PR, QRS, QT/QTc, axes
models.tested_on: PTB-XL test fold vs GE 12SL; Chapman–Shaoxing vs GE MUSE
limits: Compared with other algorithms, not a referee: the CSE database is needed for IEC 60601-2-25.
